title: The Deadline of Marseille's old port
author: V. M. Yarrow
blurb: Astrid Underhill, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
